name: AddToWallet for Simply Schedule Appointments
author: lakshayaddtowallet

sections.description:
Your customer books an appointment, and SSA’s confirmation screen offers them an Add to
Apple Wallet and Add to Google Wallet button, right below Save to calendar. The
pass carries the appointment type, the customer’s name, and the date and time, with a
barcode staff can scan.

How it works

  • The buttons appear inside SSA’s own booking form, on its confirmation screen.
  • The pass is created on your server with your AddToWallet API key. The key never reaches
    your visitors’ browsers.
  • The browser sends only the appointment id and SSA’s own appointment token, and the
    appointment details are read from SSA’s tables, so nobody can create a pass for
    someone else’s appointment or put made-up details on one.
  • Reloading the confirmation screen never creates a second pass.

Works with

  • The [ssa_booking] shortcode
  • The SSA Gutenberg block
  • Any page builder that embeds SSA’s booking form

Cancellations

When an appointment is canceled, by you or through the customer’s own cancel link, the
pass in their wallet is marked expired straight away.

Requirements

  • Simply Schedule Appointments (free or paid editions)
  • An AddToWallet account and API key

External services

This plugin connects to the AddToWallet API at https://app.addtowallet.co to create and
expire Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes. Without this service it cannot issue passes.

When a customer’s appointment qualifies for a pass, the plugin sends these details from your
server to AddToWallet: the service name, appointment date and time, staff member, customer
name, customer email and phone number, the appointment id, and the logo and colors you
configured. It also sends your API key to authenticate the request. When an appointment is
cancelled, it sends the pass id so the pass can be expired. Your API key is never sent to
the customer’s browser.

The service is provided by AddToWallet: Terms of Service,
Privacy Policy.
sections.faq:
Which appointments get a pass?

Booked appointments, unless you choose otherwise. You can also issue passes for
appointments waiting on payment, though that payment may still fail.

No buttons appear. What should I check?

  • You are out of AddToWallet credits.
  • The appointment has a status you do not issue passes for.
  • Your booking form redirects to another page after booking, so SSA never shows its
    confirmation screen.

The Bookings & passes tab lists every appointment and whether it received a pass.

Does expiring a pass refund the credit?

No. Each pass costs one credit when it is created.
